Multi-objective reliability based design optimization using Kriging surrogate model for cementless hip prosthesis

High FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Direct Read now simulation_case UQ
Khalil Dammak, Abdelkhalak El Hami Computer Methods in Biomechanics & Biomedical Engineering 2020-06-01 10.1080/10255842.2020.1768247
单位: Laboratory of Mechanics of Normandy (LMN), INSA Rouen Normandy, University of Rouen, St Etienne de Rouvray, France
通讯: Khalil Dammak @ Laboratory of Mechanics of Normandy (LMN), INSA Rouen Normandy, University of Rouen, St Etienne de Rouvray, France
相关性: 该论文直接针对无骨水泥髋关节假体，结合有限元仿真、代理模型和多目标可靠性优化，与用户的研究方向高度吻合。
边界: This paper does not include uncertainty quantification beyond reliability analysis, nor does it address surrogate model transferability to other implant designs or biomechanical contexts.
动机· 确定性优化导致假体设计不可靠，需考虑不确定性。
方法· 提出结合有限元仿真、Kriging代理模型和C-NSGA-II的多目标可靠性优化方法。
结果· 混合方法生成的Pareto解集分布良好且可靠。
验证· 通过误差预测和交叉验证比较代理模型精度。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Deterministic optimization of cementless hip prostheses yields unreliable designs due to ignored uncertainties.
Method· A multi-objective reliability-based design optimization procedure combining finite element simulation, Kriging surrogate modeling, and constrained NSGA-II is proposed.
Result· The hybrid method generates well-distributed and reliable Pareto solutions.
Validation· Surrogate models are validated using error predictions and cross-validation.

Motivation· To address the shortage of donor organs by advancing 3D bioprinting technology through deep learning integration.
Method· This perspective paper reviews potential applications of deep learning in various stages of 3D bioprinting, including medical image processing, printing parameter optimization, and post-printing tissue maturation.
Result· The paper proposes that deep learning can accelerate bioprinting workflows and enable patient-specific tissue fabrication, but provides no experimental evidence.

Functionality-packed additively manufactured porous titanium implants

Ingmar A. J. van Hengel, F.S.A. Gelderman, S. Athanasiadis, Michelle Minneboo, Harrie Weinans et al. Materials Today Bio 2020-06-01 10.1016/j.mtbio.2020.100060
单位: Additive Manufacturing Laboratory, Department of Biomechanical Engineering, Faculty of Mechanical, Maritime, and Materials Engineering, Delft University of Technology, the Netherlands
通讯: Ingmar A. J. van Hengel @ Additive Manufacturing Laboratory, Department of Biomechanical Engineering, Faculty of Mechanical, Maritime, and Materia
相关性: 该论文涉及多孔钛植入物的增材制造和生物功能化，但未直接研究应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
边界: No stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, and no stiffness matching evaluation.
动机· 开发兼具抗感染和骨整合功能的多孔钛植入物
方法· 选择性激光熔化制备多孔Ti-6Al-4V，等离子电解氧化负载锶和银离子
结果· 实现持续28天的离子释放，完全杀灭耐药菌并增强成骨活性

Motivation· To design a porous titanium implant that simultaneously prevents infection and promotes bone integration.
Method· Selective laser melting was used to fabricate porous Ti-6Al-4V scaffolds, followed by plasma electrolytic oxidation to incorporate strontium and silver ions.
Result· Sustained release of both ions for 28 days, complete eradication of multidrug-resistant Staphylococcus aureus, and enhanced alkaline phosphatase activity.
Validation· In vitro antibacterial assays and an ex vivo murine infection model.

单位: Duke University
通讯: Bijan Abar @ Duke University
相关性: 该论文直接研究了LPBF钛合金的表面形貌对力学和生物学性能的影响，但未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
边界: This paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, does not cover fatigue testing, and focuses on surface roughness effects on mechanical and biological properties without implant-level validation.
动机· 探究3D打印钛表面粗糙度对力学和生物学性能的影响
方法· 通过LPBF打印不同表面粗糙度的钛狗骨和圆盘，进行拉伸测试和细胞实验
结果· 打印粗糙度降低了延展性，但对细胞增殖无显著差异，粗糙组骨钙素表达降低

Motivation· To understand how surface roughness of 3D printed titanium affects its mechanical and biological properties.
Method· Titanium dog bones and discs were fabricated via laser powder bed fusion with five surface roughness groups, followed by tensile testing and in vitro cell assays.
Result· Printed roughness significantly reduced ductility, while cell adhesion and proliferation were similar across groups, but rough groups showed diminished osteocalcin gene expression.
Validation· Mechanical tensile testing and in vitro cell culture experiments with MC3T3 preosteoblasts.

Method· A random effects Bayesian framework is developed that treats model discrepancy as a random variable, enabling joint inference of parameters and discrepancy.

单位: Department of Mechanical Engineering, The University of Iowa, Iowa City, IA 52242
通讯: Min-Yeong Moon @ Department of Mechanical Engineering, The University of Iowa, Iowa City, IA 52242
相关性: 该论文提出的基于置信度的不确定性量化与模型验证方法，可迁移至生物力学植入物有限元代理模型的验证与不确定性评估。
边界: This paper does not address surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, nor does it apply to biomedical implant design or biomechanics.
动机· 针对冲击问题中稀疏实验数据与材料不确定性，开发验证模型的置信度方法。
方法· 构建仿真与实验输出分布，计算中位数误差和模型置信度指标。

Motivation· To develop statistical confidence metrics for validating computational models under aleatoric/epistemic uncertainties and sparse experimental data in high-speed impact problems.
Method· Probability density functions of QoI ratios are constructed from simulation ensembles and sparse experimental data, and two metrics (median prediction error and model confidence at a user-specified error level) are computed.
Result· The simulation model predicts final length more accurately than final diameter, and the confidence levels are consistent with physical expectations.
Validation· The method is demonstrated on the Taylor impact of a copper bar using sparse experimental data from literature.

Motivation· To reduce the high computational cost of electromagnetic-driven antenna design by addressing the curse of dimensionality in conventional surrogate models.
Method· A two-stage Gaussian process regression surrogate is built within a confined domain defined by nested kriging, blending sparse high-fidelity and dense low-fidelity simulation data.
Result· The proposed method achieves significant computational savings in training data acquisition while maintaining high predictive accuracy, outperforming conventional surrogates.
Validation· Numerical benchmarking on two antenna examples demonstrates superiority over standard GPR and unconfined domain surrogates.

Motivation· To develop a friction formulation that accurately models tangential debonding at osseointegrated implant interfaces.

Method· A constrained optimization constructs lattice beams aligned with principal stress directions, ensuring conformity at intersections by computing aspect ratios.
Result· The technique provides global and local stress field visualization, with coherent updates under varying loads or material parameters.
Validation· Demonstrated on several non-trivial test scenarios.

Motivation· To investigate the effect of scan strategies on the compressive load capacity of AlSi12 lattice structures fabricated by selective laser melting.
Method· Different scan orders (outside-in vs. inside-out) and scan patterns (concentric vs. stripe with 67° rotation) were applied, and the resulting mechanical properties and microstructures were analyzed.
Result· Outside-in scan order improved mechanical properties by preventing grain coarsening at strut centers, while stripe pattern reduced geometrical accuracy but increased hardness due to finer grain size.
Validation· Compression testing and microstructural analysis (grain size, orientation) were used to validate the findings.

Motivation· This study investigates how variations in osteocyte lacunar size and orientation produce micro-heterogeneity in strain fields, potentially explaining heterogeneous osteocyte activation under mechanical load.
Method· A multiscale finite element approach was used, combining idealized and confocal-image-based geometries of multiple osteocytes, with parametric analysis of perilacunar modulus (5-20 GPa).
Result· Lacunar strains decreased by 14% in cell body, 15% in fluid space, and 25% in perilacunar matrix with increasing modulus; lacunae aligned along the loading axis showed lower strains.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To compare patient satisfaction between total hip and total knee arthroplasty using the Forgotten Joint Score.
Method· A retrospective review of FJS-12 questionnaire responses at 3, 12, and 21 months postoperatively, analyzed with t-tests and linear regression.
Result· THA patients had significantly higher FJS-12 scores than TKA patients at all time points, with a marginal increase with age.
Validation· Statistical analysis of 2,359 patient responses from an electronic rehabilitation application.

单位: Department of Orthopaedics, University of Kentucky, Lexington, Kentucky
通讯: Stephen T. Duncan @ Department of Orthopaedics, University of Kentucky, Lexington, Kentucky
相关性: 该论文仅关注全髋关节置换术的经济成本和临床结果，未涉及任何生物力学分析或植入物力学性能。
边界: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or any biomechanical metrics; it is purely a health economics and clinical outcomes study.
动机· 评估不同假体选择对全髋关节置换术捆绑支付模式下成本的影响。
方法· 回顾性分析2014-2018年数据库，倾向评分匹配比较R3/Polarstem与陶瓷聚乙烯组。
结果· R3/Polarstem组住院时间更短，出院回家比例更高，再入院率更低，但总成本略高。
验证· 基于大型数据库的回顾性统计分析。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the impact of cementless implant and bearing choice on hospital costs and clinical outcomes under bundled payment models for total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A retrospective analysis of the Premier Perspective database from 2014 to 2018Q3, using 1:3 propensity score matching to compare R3 cup/Polarstem with oxidized zirconium bearing versus ceramic-on-polyethylene cementless systems.
Result· The R3/Polarstem group had significantly shorter length of stay, higher likelihood of home discharge, lower transfusion and readmission rates, but slightly higher total hospital costs.
Validation· Statistical analysis of a large administrative database with propensity score matching and regression models.

边界: This paper does not quantify femoral stem stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics; it focuses on acetabular component wear and osteolysis in a clinical case.

方法· 分析双侧全髋置换术后17年和19年的临床病例

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To demonstrate the clinical significance of acetabular component positioning on polyethylene liner wear and periprosthetic osteolysis.
Method· A clinical case of bilateral total hip arthroplasty with 17- and 19-year follow-up was analyzed using radiographs, CT, and intraoperative findings.
Result· Greater anteversion of the right acetabular component (40.3°) was associated with more severe liner wear and osteolysis compared to the left (25.4°).
Validation· Clinical follow-up and revision surgery observations.

Motivation· To summarize three landmark clinical trials on the management of fractured neck of femur for clinicians.
Method· Review of three large prospective randomized clinical trials published in high-impact journals.
Result· Key clinical findings on total hip arthroplasty vs hemiarthroplasty, fast-track care, and sliding hip screw vs multiple cancellous screws are presented.
Validation· No original validation; relies on published trial results.
